This Petition, along with Petition No. 385/GT/2020 (tariff of the generating station for the period 201924) was heard through video conferencing, on 15.3.2022, and the Commission, after directing the Petitioner, to submit certain additional information, reserved its order in both petitions. In compliance to the above directions, the Petitioner has filed the additional information vide affidavit dated 2.5.2022, after serving copies to the Respondents. The Respondent TANGEDCO has also filed the note of the arguments made during the hearing on 15.3.2022.
